description_en: Queries the call details of a specified robot outbound call task
description_zh: 查看指定机器人外呼任务的话单详情
name: QueryCallDetailByTaskId

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the robot call task. This ID is returned after a robot outbound call task is successfully created. You can view the ID in Task Management (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/job/list) of the Voice Service console, or record the TaskId parameter returned after you successfully call the BatchRobotSmartCall operation
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID，成功下发机器人外呼任务后返回。可以在语音控制台任务管理 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/job/list)中查看，或调用接口BatchRobotSmartCall成功后记录返回的参数TaskId
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the robot outbound call task. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 机器人外呼任务的开始时间。Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: query_date

parameters.help_en: The called number. Currently, you can view the outbound call records of only one called number at a time
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。当前仅支持查看一个被叫号码的外呼记录
parameters.name: callee

Code.description_en:
The status code of the request.
OK: The request is successful.
For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）

Data.description_en:
The call details of the robot outbound call task, in JSON format. The parameters include:
startDate: the answer time.
stateDesc: the hang-up cause. If an early media status code is present, the cause associated with the early media code is used.
statusCode: the status code.
endDate: the end time.
calleeShowNumber: the caller ID.
callee: the called number.
duration: the billable duration.
gmtCreate: the creation time.
hangupDirection: the hang-up direction.
tags: the tags.
dialogCount: the number of dialog turns.
sureCount: the number of affirmative responses.
denyCount: the number of negative responses.
rejectCount: the number of rejections.
customCount: the number of custom responses.
knowledgeCount: the number of knowledge base hits.
recordFile: the download URL of the recording file. The URL expires in 48 hours. Download the file promptly.
callId: the call ID.
recordStatus: the status of the recording file. Valid values:
    - 1: A recording file is available.
    - 2: No recording file is available.
knowledgeCommonCount: the word count of common questions in the knowledge base.
knowledgeBusinessCount: the word count of business questions in the knowledge base.
callee: the called number.
dialogDetail: the dialog details in a JSON array. The array includes the following fields:
    - role: the speaker.
    - content: the spoken content.
    - time: the time of the speech.

The returned fields are for reference only. The actual returned parameters prevail
